svg.title: Collected
svg.desc: Touching the invisible, Electric traces, Sensing the hand, Hands in hardware, Training in another world, Kinetic feedback, Mechanical fingers, A camera on the wrist, Physical feedback in VR, A charged gauntlet

g.title: Touching the invisible — A hand, a fern, and a delicate layer of responsive digital geometry.
Electric traces — Luminous currents behaving like drawn lines inside glass.
Sensing the hand — A flex-sensor glove translating finger motion into a wearable interface.
Hands in hardware — A small articulated hand mechanism assembled and explored at a workbench.
Training in another world — A VR sports-training concept connecting physical movement with virtual timing.
Kinetic feedback — An impact-training apparatus that makes movement and resistance tangible.
Mechanical fingers — A compact, sensor-rich hand mechanism as inspiration for wearable interfaces.
A camera on the wrist — A concept collage for a wrist-mounted camera with a scope and tactile controls.
Physical feedback in VR — A reference collage exploring recoil and embodied feedback in simulated training.
A charged gauntlet — A glowing plasma globe meets an ornate wearable prop inspired by Arcane.
